pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Physical has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   D. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   B. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   C. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Healing of of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sharing values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Obedience values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Church as a By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. A — Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. B — Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. D — Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Healing of of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Church as a By the end of the Sub strand; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
